name: Wizard OS Tracker
short_desc: Goals and Bugs on GitHub: Open → Build → Review, who does each step, issue on tap.
author: Humanity Labs
description: Two views over a GitHub organisation, Goals and Bugs, each showing the workflow as three hand-off steps (1 Open → 2 Build → 3 Review, then Done) with counts and exactly who may do each step, bottleneck stats, a Wizard OS Builder on/off switch (mock-up), and Everyone/repo filters. Tap an issue to read it and its comments in the app. Each person signs in with their own GitHub token.
